implementation: Accept the original UX proposal and all PM constraints. In the existing single-invoice table, derive the monetary heading from paid status: AMOUNT PAID with settlement.amount ?? amountDue after settlement, otherwise AMOUNT DUE with amountDue. Keep filters, counts and settlement records unchanged. Reuse the existing exact approval-event/credit-event revision linkage and actual creditNote.reference to derive a display-only historical detail in both Activity and Evidence. The helper should describe the recorded approval amount and invoice version and name the linked superseding credit. Preserve event.title, event.detail, expiry annotation, signatures, state and JSON; current or ambiguous events keep their original description. The data is already present, so no new API or evidence field is required. Restrict edits to src/App.tsx, with src/styles.css only if the longer heading needs narrow-screen accommodation. Verification can inspect retained paid evidence and the already-created fresh scenario without resetting or paying an old obligation again. This is the final authorized improvement cycle; subsequent observations are reported rather than used to initiate a third cycle.
risks: The state-dependent table heading is valid for the current one-invoice workspace only. A future mixed paid/unpaid table would need a separately accepted design.

Historical supporting text must share the same proven expiry predicate as the existing annotation. If event amount or exact credit linkage is absent, retain the original detail instead of inventing a value or inferring from amounts.
Only rendered descriptions change. Mutating event.detail or exported JSON would exceed scope and break preservation of original evidence.

The previous paid record was archived through a parent-authorized reset and remains preserved. Targeted cosmetic verification must not repeat its payment or claim the new obligation is that same record.

Browser regression remains fresh-context non-isolated usability evidence, separate from the already reported compiled SBF and devnet checks. No additional production, accounting-certification or accessibility-audit claim follows.
taskSplit: After final PM acceptance, UX builder adjusts only the paid/unpaid list label/value and the shared historical approval display helper in src/App.tsx; use src/styles.css only for necessary narrow-heading layout.
Parent runs typecheck and production build and confirms event objects, server/program files, export contents and operational behavior are unchanged.

Fresh-context reviewer checks unpaid/paid monetary semantics and historical/current descriptions at desktop and 390 px using the preserved completed evidence and available scenario. Avoid unnecessary additional resets or payments for cosmetic checks.

Parent records bounded cycle-2 verification and remaining deferred export/accessibility observations without starting another improvement cycle; parent retains sole control-plane and shared-budget ownership.
